demo.welcome.adminIntro: This is a test administrator dashboard. You can safely explore workspace, catalog, employee, finance, and settings management.

demo.welcome.employeeStepTwo: Add products or services, start a timer, and try completing a payment.

help.admin.start.title: Getting started
help.admin.start.summary: The recommended order for setting up a new organization.
help.admin.start.step1: Check the language, currency, and time zone in "Settings". You can change the interface language at any time.
help.admin.start.step2: Create categories to group products, services, and places.
help.admin.start.step3: Add places and arrange them on the workspace layout the way they are in your venue.
help.admin.start.step4: Fill in the catalog: products, services, and combo sets if you need them.
help.admin.start.step5: Enter opening stock in inventory through a purchase.
help.admin.start.step6: Add employees, set up shift templates, and set the finance PIN.
help.admin.places.title: Places and workspace layout
help.admin.places.summary: Places are tables, rooms, game zones, or counters that orders are attached to.
help.admin.places.step1: Click "Create place" and enter the name, category, and capacity.
help.admin.places.step2: If time at the place is billed hourly, enable the timer and set the hourly rate, minimum minutes, and billing step.
help.admin.places.step3: On a computer, drag a card by the top handle and resize it by the bottom-right corner.
help.admin.places.step4: Archive a place you no longer use: its order history is kept.
help.admin.catalog.title: Catalog: products, services, and combos
help.admin.catalog.summary: Everything an employee can add to an order.
help.admin.catalog.step1: A product is something tracked in inventory: drinks, snacks, accessories. Set the sale price and unit of measure.
help.admin.catalog.step2: A service is not deducted from inventory. Its price can be fixed, hourly, or entered manually at payment.
help.admin.catalog.step3: A combo bundles several products and services at a special price. The system checks stock availability automatically.
help.admin.catalog.step4: Add photos so employees find items in the menu faster.
help.admin.catalog.step5: A product with sales history cannot be deleted, but it can be archived.
help.admin.inventory.title: Inventory
help.admin.inventory.summary: Product stock changes automatically with sales and through inventory documents.
help.admin.inventory.step1: Record purchases with the "Stock purchase" button: choose products, quantities, and the total amount. The unit price is calculated automatically, and the total goes to expenses.
help.admin.inventory.step2: If a purchase includes a new product, you can create it right in the form. It stays disabled in the catalog until you set a sale price.
help.admin.inventory.step3: Use an adjustment for recounts, spoilage, or input errors, and always give the reason.
help.admin.inventory.step4: Set a minimum stock level to see which products need restocking.
help.admin.employees.title: Employees and access
help.admin.employees.summary: Who works in the organization and what they can do.
help.admin.employees.step1: Your Freedom Platform manager creates the sign-in account. Then find the employee by email and add them with their name, position, and phone.
help.admin.employees.step2: Give the employee a 4-digit workspace screen PIN: they use it to lock and unlock the screen during a shift.
help.admin.employees.step3: If an employee requested a new PIN, approve or reject the request on the employees page.
help.admin.employees.step4: Disable access for an employee who has left. Their activity history is kept.
help.admin.shifts.title: Shifts and cash register
help.admin.shifts.summary: All sales and payments happen within a shift. The employee who opened the shift is responsible for the cash register.
help.admin.shifts.step1: Create shift templates, for example "First" and "Second". Times are not fixed: totals are calculated from the actual opening and closing.
help.admin.shifts.step2: When opening, the employee enters the starting cash amount. Expected cash = opening cash + cash sales.
help.admin.shifts.step3: When closing, the employee counts the cash. If there is a discrepancy, they must write a comment.
help.admin.shifts.step4: Open orders and active sessions are handed over to the next shift automatically.
help.admin.shifts.step5: Shift details show revenue, payments by method, discrepancies, and the activity log.
help.admin.orders.title: Orders and payments
help.admin.orders.summary: How employees handle orders and what the administrator sees.
help.admin.orders.step1: An order is created at a place or without a place (for example, a takeaway sale).
help.admin.orders.step2: For places with a timer, the employee starts a session. The system calculates the cost of time from the place rate.
help.admin.orders.step3: Payment is accepted in cash, by card, or as a split payment. Some items can be paid now and the rest later.
help.admin.orders.step4: If the customer does not pay, the order is closed as a payment refusal with a comment or recorded as a debt.
help.admin.orders.step5: Every order change is logged: you can see who added or removed an item and when.
help.admin.debts.title: Customer debts
help.admin.debts.summary: Orders the customer will pay later.
help.admin.debts.step1: The employee records the order as a debt with the customer's name, phone, and due date.
help.admin.debts.step2: A debt does not go into the cash register until the customer pays. Payment can be accepted in parts.
help.admin.debts.step3: Overdue debts are highlighted in red.
help.admin.finance.title: Finance
help.admin.finance.summary: Income, expenses, profit, and financial periods. The section is protected by the finance PIN.
help.admin.finance.step1: Set a 4-digit finance PIN in "Settings". Without it, finance sections are locked, and they lock again after 15 minutes of inactivity.
help.admin.finance.step2: Income from paid orders appears automatically. Add other income manually.
help.admin.finance.step3: Enter expenses: rent, salaries, utilities. Set up repeating expenses as recurring.
help.admin.finance.step4: P&L shows profit by accrual date; Cash flow shows money movement by payment date.
help.admin.finance.step5: At the end of the month, close the financial period to lock the figures. You can reopen it if needed.
help.admin.monitoring.title: Monitoring and activity log
help.admin.monitoring.summary: What is happening in the organization right now and who changed what.
help.admin.monitoring.step1: "Place monitoring" shows occupied places, timers, and order totals in real time, including on a phone.
help.admin.monitoring.step2: The "Log" records important actions: orders, payments, shifts, and changes to places and finances.
help.admin.monitoring.step3: Filter the log by author, source, and operation type to find an event quickly.
help.admin.settings.title: Settings
help.admin.settings.step1: The interface language (Russian, Azerbaijani, or English) is saved on this device for the administrator and employees.
help.admin.settings.step2: The finance PIN is also set and changed here. You need your account password for this.
help.admin.settings.step3: In the notifications section, connect Telegram for messages about shifts and the cash register.
help.employee.openShift.title: Opening a shift
help.employee.openShift.summary: You cannot create orders or accept payments without an open shift.
help.employee.openShift.step1: Open the "Shift" section and choose a shift template.
help.employee.openShift.step2: Count the cash in the register and enter the starting amount.
help.employee.openShift.step3: Read the cash register rules and confirm the opening.
help.employee.workspace.title: Orders on the dashboard
help.employee.workspace.summary: The dashboard shows all places and their status.
help.employee.workspace.step1: Tap a free place to open an order. For a sale without a place, use "Order without a place".
help.employee.workspace.step2: Add products, services, and combos from the menu. Change the quantity with the + and − buttons.
help.employee.workspace.step3: For places with a timer, tap "Start session". If the customer moves, use "Change place": the order moves with them.
help.employee.workspace.step4: If you make a mistake, remove the item: the action is recorded in the log the administrator sees.
help.employee.payment.title: Accepting payment
help.employee.payment.summary: Always check the total and the payment method before accepting payment.
help.employee.payment.step1: End the session first, then move the order to payment.
help.employee.payment.step2: Choose "Cash", "Card", or a split payment if the customer pays in two ways.
help.employee.payment.step3: Record tips in the system: they go into the cash register.
help.employee.payment.step4: If the customer promises to pay later, record the order as a debt. Never close such an order as paid.
help.employee.closeShift.title: Closing a shift
help.employee.closeShift.summary: Reconcile the cash register and hand over unfinished orders to the next shift.
help.employee.closeShift.step1: Count the actual cash and enter it in the "Actual cash" field.
help.employee.closeShift.step2: Compare it with the expected cash. If you are short or over, write a short, honest comment.
help.employee.closeShift.step3: Click "End shift". Open orders and active sessions move to the next shift.
help.employee.lock.title: Screen lock
help.employee.lock.summary: Lock the screen whenever you step away from the workspace.
help.employee.lock.step1: Tap "Lock screen" and unlock it with your 4-digit PIN.
help.employee.lock.step2: A new PIN starts working only after the administrator approves it.
help.faq1.q: Why can't an employee create an order?
help.faq1.a: Most likely the shift is not open. Open a shift in the "Shift" section.
help.faq2.a: Finances are protected by a PIN. Set it in "Settings" and enter it when you open the section.
help.faq3.q: How do I correct product stock?
help.faq3.a: Open "Inventory" and make an adjustment with a reason. Every change is saved in the product history.
help.faq4.q: Can I work from a phone?
help.faq4.a: The administrator can view the overview, orders, shifts, finances, and monitoring from a phone. The employee workspace is designed for a computer or tablet.
help.faq5.q: How do I change the language?
help.faq5.a: Open "Settings" and choose the interface language. It applies immediately.
